beats.care: In a PG, hostel or society? Expect tighter supply in coming months. Store some water and report leaks.
beats.what: The water resources department told 38 users, including PMC, PCMC, industries, colleges and housing societies, to cut water use by 20%.
beats.why: Dams hold less than last year and drought is declared in 10 Pune talukas. Drinking water must last till next monsoon.

cards.body: That's nearly 12% less than the same time last year, the water department said.

cards.body: Illegal pumps can be seized, and power connections cut, where water theft is found.

cards.q: If water runs short, what gets first priority?
cards.why: Officials say drinking water comes first, then irrigation and other needs.

cover.label: Cut ordered for PMC, PCMC and 36 others

hook: Why are Pune's *civic bodies told to use less water*?

learn.t: The Khadakwasla dam chain holds about 25 TMC, nearly 12% less than this time last year.

tldr: The state water department has told 38 users of Khadakwasla water, including PMC and PCMC, to cut their use by 20% amid drought fears.
watch: Watch for PMC's call on whether Pune gets a second no-water day each week.
